verdict.reasons: The core product is correctly identified as the white-and-blue upright cylindrical AFP drip-tape carton roll, matching the reference guide. The branding, including the 'AFP' text and Persian captions, is authentic, readable, and seamlessly integrated into the 3D cylinder geometry, avoiding any 'pasted' or counterfeit appearance. The commercial product count is exactly 1. The scene is highly suitable for an agronomy article, showing the product as a reference item next to the installed drip lines and neutral seedlings. The required legitimate watermark 'AFP | 09134922013' is present and correctly formatted. There are minor advisory notes: the installed laterals appear somewhat uniform and slightly thick for a fine tape lateral, and the package is sitting directly on the soil rather than in a perfect clearance gap, but these are practical scene elements rather than core defects. The overall image quality is coherent, well-lit, and editorially useful.

focused_physical_review.reason: An installed black lateral irrigation line is visibly in contact with the base of the AFP package on its right side; there is no uninterrupted soil gap around the package footprint due to this physical intersection with the line. There are no additional loose coils, and no strips or tape tails protruding from the carton.
